anchor.text: Dear Mother I am sick. I want to go home. Please come and take me home. I am in the infirmary. Your fond son, Stephen
anchor.prefix: d they written home to tell his mother and father? But it would be quicker for one of the priests to go himself to tell them. Or he would write a letter for the priest to bring.
anchor.suffix: How far away they were! There was cold sunlight outside the window. He wondered if he would die. You could die just the same on a sunny day. He might die before his mother came.
anchor.canonical_text:
Dear Mother,

I am sick. I want to go home. Please come and take me home. I am in the infirmary.

Your fond son,
Stephen
